replies.text:
Hi Sir,

Please find my inputs for the upcoming QBE below.

*1. Baby Pure Oil*
Around 90% of the sales come from the Outright (OR) model. As per the OR
data, we are on track with the target.

*2. Shampoo – Hibiscus Trileaf & Anti-Dandruff (250 ml)*
Both are selling through the OR model. There is a gap in Hibiscus 250 ml
because of an EAN mismatch, so I am not able to fulfil those orders. To
cover this, I have started selling through a live DF FCID and am running
ads on it.

*3. Baby Scalp Oil*
This is fully sold through the OR model, and we are in line with the target
here as well.

*4. Netraa Cream*
This product has a low COGS (-20), and we are making 25% CM2 on it.

*5. Henna Combo*
This product is currently running with low visibility.

*6. Flora Jal*
I have listed it in two categories on FirstCry, Toner and Facial Spray, to
gain more market share. One of these FCIDs is listed on the OR model, which
is why there is a gap.

*Summary Numbers*

*FirstCry* (Target / Estimated Achievement)
Primary (₹ L): – / 46.42
Secondary (₹ L): 54 / 49.68
Discounting (%): 19.5% / 19.5%
Spend (₹ L): 13 / 12
SLA (%): – / –

*CRED* (Target / Estimated Achievement)

Discounting (%): 70% / 63%

SLA (%): – / –

Please let me know if you need any more details.

 Regards,
Harsh Kalani
